vel: A literatura é a maneira mais agradável de ignorar a vida.
Literature is the most agreeable way of ignoring life.
A liberdade é a possibilidade do isolamento... Se te é impossível viver só, nasceste escravo.
Freedom is the possibility of isolation... If you can't live alone, you were born a slave.
vely: She saw time naïvely as a road laid out. You walked ahead, and you got somewhere. If you were lucky, you got somewhere worth getting to.
